compare.measurement_cumulative_note: - Note: run_02+ uses accumulative mode (revision chain: drafts revising the previous elevated artifact → elevation).

render.title: # Comparison: raw AI generation vs elevated
render.disclaimer: > This document is material for demonstrating the elevation advantage. **The conclusion is not decided by numbers — you read both and judge.** Numbers are an aid for objectivity; note that single-call generation (≈1 call) and integration (8 drafts × temp 0.7 → reasoning → finalization, ≈10 calls) differ in cost by an order of magnitude.
